exposure: Children's night waking patterns (wakes of >=20 minutes)
Mothers' parenting cognitions and behaviours (lower sense of parenting impact, higher overprotectiveness, lower self-efficacy, higher coerciveness)
Fathers' parenting cognitions and behaviours (lower sense of parenting impact, higher overprotectiveness)
outcome: Children's behavioural difficulties (externalizing behaviours, internalizing behaviours, shyness/inhibition, aggression/hyperactivity)
cohort: The study included 1487 families from the Quebec Longitudinal Study of Child Development, with children observed from 5 to 29 months of age.
finding: Extended night-time waking patterns in 29-month-old children were associated with mothers' and fathers' negative parenting cognitions and behaviours, and with higher scores on children's externalizing and internalizing behavioral problems.
